code:
import ipaddress

def report(cidr):
    net = ipaddress.ip_network(cidr, strict=False)
    h = net.max_prefixlen - net.prefixlen
    print(f"{cidr}")
    print(f"  network address : {net.network_address}")
    print(f"  broadcast       : {net.broadcast_address}")
    print(f"  netmask         : {net.netmask}")
    print(f"  wildcard        : {net.hostmask}")
    print(f"  host bits       : {h}")
    print(f"  block size      : {2**h}")
    print(f"  usable hosts    : {net.num_addresses - 2}")
    print(f"  range           : {net.network_address + 1} .. {net.broadcast_address - 1}")

print("=== subnet arithmetic (4-step method) ===")
for c in ("192.168.10.130/26", "172.16.5.9/20", "10.1.2.3/30"):
    report(c)
    print()

print("=== same-subnet test: must use the SAME mask ===")
net26 = ipaddress.ip_network("192.168.10.128/26", strict=False)
for a, b in (("192.168.10.130", "192.168.10.190"), ("192.168.10.130", "192.168.10.193")):
    same = ipaddress.ip_address(a) in net26 and ipaddress.ip_address(b) in net26
    print(f"  {a:<16} vs {b:<16} in /26 -> {same}"
          + ("" if same else "   (different subnet: must go via gateway)"))

print()
print("=== subnetting: split 192.168.1.0/24 for 4 departments, >=25 hosts each ===")
need, base = 25, 24
best = None
# 从最长前缀往后退，第一个「可用主机数 >= need」的就是最省的划分
for plen in range(30, base - 1, -1):
    n = ipaddress.ip_network(f"192.168.1.0/{plen}", strict=False)
    if n.num_addresses - 2 >= need:
        best = plen
        break
n = ipaddress.ip_network(f"192.168.1.0/{best}", strict=False)
print(f"  need >= {need} usable hosts -> longest prefix that still fits = /{best} "
      f"({n.num_addresses - 2} usable, {2 ** (best - base)} such subnets in the /24)  <== smallest fit")
subs = list(ipaddress.ip_network("192.168.1.0/24").subnets(new_prefix=best))
for i, s in enumerate(subs[:4], 1):
    print(f"  dept{i}: {s}  usable {s.network_address + 1} .. {s.broadcast_address - 1}")
print(f"  4 depts use 4 x /{best}; {len(subs) - 4} x /{best} left over -> keep for future growth")
